rank_trace.sql: SELECT a.asset_name, sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value FROM assets a JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.reading_time = (SELECT MAX(sr2.reading_time) FROM sensor_readings sr2 WHERE sr2.asset_id = a.asset_id) ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC;

raw_response:
1.  SELECT a.asset_name, sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value  
    FROM assets a  
    JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id  
    WHERE sr.reading_time = (SELECT MAX(sr2.reading_time) FROM sensor_readings sr2 WHERE sr2.asset_id = a.asset_id)  
    ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC;

2.  SELECT a.asset_name, sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value  
    FROM assets a  
    JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id  
    WHERE sr.reading_id IN (SELECT sr2.reading_id FROM sensor_readings sr2 WHERE sr2.asset_id = a.asset_id ORDER BY sr2.reading_time DESC LIMIT 1)  
    ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC;

3.  SELECT a.asset_name, sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value  
    FROM assets a  
    JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id  
    JOIN (SELECT asset_id, MAX(reading_time) AS max_time FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY asset_id) latest  
      ON a.asset_id = latest.asset_id AND sr.reading_time = latest.max_time  
    ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC;
